body_concept_v1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art character concept sheet for Teamfight Manager 2, not a finished animation atlas. An ORIGINAL male rooftop free-runner street fighter, lean athletic adult, warm medium-brown skin, short swept black hair, recognisable human face, rust-red cropped track jacket over a pale undershirt, charcoal loose cargo trousers ending above the ankle, clearly ivory-taped BARE FEET and ankles, fingerless cloth wrist wraps, small jade-green graffiti spray can clipped at his hip. He fights with kicks; no handheld weapon. Simple blocky pixel drawing with a crisp dark outline, 12–16 flat colours, at most two shades per material, no tiny noisy armour detail, no smooth gradients, no photorealism. Proportions of a compact TFM2 stock melee champion: approximately 39 logical body pixels tall, normal-sized head and limbs, connected whole-body anatomy, readable at 1×. Keep the EXACT SAME athlete, clothes, proportions and soft upper-left lighting in every pose. Composition: EXACTLY eight separate full-body sprites in a clean 4-column × 2-row equal-cell grid, with generous transparent space in each cell, nothing touching cell edges. Row 1: front idle, 3/4 view facing RIGHT idle, fluid right-facing running pose left leg leading, running pose right leg leading. Row 2: right-facing kick wind-up with knee raised; powerful right-facing extended snap kick with the supporting foot grounded; right-facing compact wall-perch crouch; right-facing diagonal airborne downward kick. Render logical pixels as large aligned square blocks for reliable downscaling. All poses have consistent anatomical size; crouch and jump may change the silhouette height naturally. Fully drawn from head to feet in every cell; avoid disconnected torso/leg layers. No effects, background, shadows, floor, cell dividers, captions, numbers, text or watermark. Actual RGBA transparent background.
